problem:
The vector $v=⟨-2,-2⟩$ is rotated ${45}^{∘}$ **clockwise** about the origin. Find the image of $v$ under this rotation.

${v}^{′}=⟨$
{{field-1}}, 
{{field-2}}
$⟩$
worked_solution:
A rotation of ${45}^{∘}$ *clockwise* about the origin is represented by the matrix 

$$
{R}_{(-{45}^{∘})}=[\begin{aligned}\operatorname{cos}⁡(-{45}^{∘}) & -\operatorname{sin}⁡(-{45}^{∘}) \\ \operatorname{sin}⁡(-{45}^{∘}) & \operatorname{cos}⁡(-{45}^{∘})\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} & \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} \\ -\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} & \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\end{aligned}].
$$

To find the image ${v}^{′}$ under the action of the matrix ${R}_{(-{45}^{∘})}$, we compute the matrix product, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{v}^{′} & ={R}_{(-{45}^{∘})}\cdot v \\  & =[\begin{aligned}\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} & \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} \\ -\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} & \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}-2 \\ -2\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-2\sqrt{2} \\ 0\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the image is ${v}^{′}=⟨-2\sqrt{2},0⟩.$
